entities.name: Basilica of the Holy Sepulchre in Miechów
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Miechów, Poland, is a 14th-century Gothic basilica, with a nave and two aisles, incorporating some 13th-century Romanesque stonework. It received many privileges from Casimir of Bytom.
